name: Harley-Davidson Super Glide (Shovelhead FX)
engine: 74 or 80 cubic inch air-cooled Shovelhead V-twin, single carb
intro: The original factory custom, Shovelhead era. Points ignition, a single carb and a chain final drive on most.

G: Early Shovels use a Bendix carb, later ones a Keihin butterfly carb. Check which one you have before buying parts.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
